items.prompt: Which construction preserves the original specified decimal input 0.1 exactly?

options.text: Decimal(0.1), because every float literal is exact decimal
options.why: The float may already be approximate before Decimal sees it.

options.text: float("0.1"), because display precision changes storage
options.why: A display string does not give binary floating arithmetic decimal exactness.

options.text: round(0.1,2), which changes all later arithmetic to Decimal

options.why: This begins from the stated decimal value rather than a binary float.

items.explanation: Start from validated original decimal text, then apply an explicit context/scale/range policy.
